sprintName: Sprint zero - backend foundation and staging proof
sprintGoal: Create the private backend foundation, load the v107 fixture export, prove tenant access, operational tracker APIs, commercial redaction, import dry-run, billing test mode, feedback persistence, audit events, rollback, and smoke report before pilot data.

dayPlan.output: Private repo, develop branch, labels, milestones, board, first issues, secrets list.
dayPlan.exitGate: Repo is private and branch rules are visible.

dayPlan.output: Apps, packages, env examples, CI shell, README, API contract docs, fixture folder map.
dayPlan.exitGate: Fresh clone can install and run the empty shell.

dayPlan.output: Tenant table, users table, session shell, roles, section access, inactive-user behavior.
dayPlan.exitGate: Admin/editor/viewer can be seeded and checked.

dayPlan.output: 119 tracker-safe records, filters, status update, notes, CSV redaction, source trace.
dayPlan.exitGate: Editor can move records without seeing commercial fields.

dayPlan.output: Commercial vault schema, management-only routes, audit proof, redaction denial tests.
dayPlan.exitGate: Operations user is denied with audit evidence.

dayPlan.output: 5 source batches, dry-run, quarantine, duplicate, commit, rollback, reconciliation.
dayPlan.exitGate: Fixture import can be reversed cleanly.

dayPlan.output: USD test checkout, invoice, webhook, seat sync, feedback item, retest state, sponsor export.
dayPlan.exitGate: Test-mode billing and feedback write audit events.

dayPlan.output: Smoke commands, artifacts, release notes, issue cleanup.
dayPlan.exitGate: Smoke report proves pass/fail before pilot data.

pullRequestGates: PR links one generated issue, one owner, one test path, and one acceptance outcome.
Every query is tenant-scoped and rejects cross-tenant ids.
Operational responses exclude commercial vault and billing fields.
Sensitive allow/deny behavior writes actor, target, tenant, request id, and result.
Changed code runs against v107 fixture export expectations.
Import logic has dry-run, quarantine, rollback, and reconciliation proof.
Billing code is test-mode only until production approval.
The PR does not merge if its smoke path fails or produces missing artifacts.
acceptanceChecklist: Private repo exists with protected main, develop, labels, milestones, and project board.
v107 backend fixture JSON is split into repo seed files and loads into empty staging DB.
Admin, editor, viewer, inactive, and denied login cases pass.
Operational APIs can support Tenders and Projects without commercial fields.
Commercial vault reads require management/admin access and write audit proof.
Dry-run, quarantine, duplicate, commit, rollback, and reconciliation pass.
USD test checkout, invoice, webhook, seat sync, and lock rules pass.
Staging smoke report produces artifacts and linked failure issues.

dailyRitual.proof: Review P0 tickets, blockers, unassigned work, failing checks, and fixture drift.
One PR should touch one bounded route, schema slice, or fixture behavior.
Run seed, redaction, import, and relevant contract checks before review.
Do not leave half-working tenant, auth, redaction, or import logic hidden.
Write issue status, failing gate, next command, owner, and smoke artifact expectation.

stopRules: Stop for commercial fields returned by operational tracker APIs.
Stop for sensitive allow/deny actions without audit events.
Stop for import commit without rollback id or reconciliation output.
Stop for billing code using live credentials before approval.
Stop for a passing claim without artifact evidence.
